records.title: Cleaning glass windows without streaks
records.problem: streaks and dirt on windows
instructions: Remove loose dust with a dry microfiber cloth.
Mix equal parts white vinegar and warm water in a spray bottle.
Spray lightly onto the glass surface.
Wipe in an S-shaped motion using a clean microfiber cloth.
Buff dry with a second dry microfiber cloth.
donts: Do not use abrasive pads
Do not clean in direct sunlight if possible

warnings: Never mix vinegar with bleach-based products.

records.title: Cleaning a fabric couch with visible dirt or stains
records.problem: visible stains and dirt on fabric upholstery
instructions: Vacuum the couch thoroughly to remove loose dust and debris.
Blot stained areas gently with a clean cloth.
Use a mild upholstery-safe cleaner on affected areas.
Test any cleaner on a small hidden area first.
Allow the couch to dry fully before use.
dos: Check the care label if available
donts: Do not soak the fabric
Do not use bleach unless manufacturer guidance allows it
Do not scrub harshly

warnings: Test cleaning products on a hidden area first
Ensure the room is ventilated while cleaning

records.title: Cleaning mirrors without smears
records.problem: smears and marks on a mirror
instructions: Dust the mirror lightly before applying cleaner.
Spray cleaner onto a cloth rather than directly onto the mirror if possible.
Wipe evenly with a lint-free or microfiber cloth.
Buff dry to remove smears.
donts: Do not oversaturate mirror edges

records.title: Cleaning stainless steel appliances safely
records.problem: fingerprints and smudges on stainless steel appliances
instructions: Wipe the surface with a soft cloth dampened with warm water and mild dish soap.
Remove soap residue with a clean damp cloth.
Dry immediately with a microfiber cloth.
Polish in the direction of the grain.
dos: Follow the grain of the steel
donts: Do not use steel wool
Do not use bleach or chlorine-based cleaners

warnings: Abrasive materials may scratch the finish.

records.title: Cleaning an air fryer basket safely
records.problem: grease and burnt residue in an air fryer basket
instructions: Unplug the air fryer and allow it to cool completely.
Remove the basket and tray and discard loose crumbs.
Soak removable parts in warm water with mild dish soap for 10 to 20 minutes.
Use a soft sponge or nylon brush to clean away grease.
For stubborn residue, apply a paste of baking soda and water, leave for 10 minutes, then gently scrub.
Rinse thoroughly and dry fully before reassembling.
dos: Use a soft sponge or nylon brush
donts: Do not use steel wool
Do not scratch the non-stick coating
Do not immerse the main electrical unit in water

warnings: Always unplug before cleaning.
Avoid water contact with electrical parts.

records.title: Cleaning oven door glass
records.problem: grease and baked-on marks on oven door glass
instructions: Ensure the oven is fully switched off and cool.
Wipe away loose crumbs and residue.
Apply a paste of baking soda and water to greasy areas.
Leave for 10 to 15 minutes.
Wipe away with a damp non-abrasive cloth.
Buff the glass dry.
dos: Allow the oven to cool first
donts: Do not use metal scourers
Do not apply excessive water near electrical areas

warnings: Ensure oven is cool before cleaning.

records.title: Cleaning a glass or ceramic hob
records.problem: burn marks, grease, and food residue on hob
instructions: Allow the hob to cool completely unless manufacturer guidance states otherwise.
Wipe away loose crumbs with a soft cloth.
Apply a hob-safe cleaner or mild dish soap solution.
Use a soft cloth or non-abrasive pad to loosen residue.
Wipe clean with a damp cloth.
Dry and buff with a clean microfiber cloth.
dos: Use products intended for glass or ceramic hobs
donts: Do not use abrasive scouring pads
Do not scrape with sharp metal tools unless using a proper hob scraper correctly

warnings: Ensure the hob is switched off before cleaning.

records.title: Descaling a kettle safely
records.problem: limescale build-up inside a kettle
instructions: Fill the kettle halfway with equal parts water and white vinegar.
Leave the solution to sit for 20 to 30 minutes.
Pour it away and rinse several times with clean water.
Boil fresh water once or twice and discard before normal use.
donts: Do not leave strong descaling solutions in contact longer than needed

warnings: Rinse well before boiling drinking water.

records.title: Cleaning a fridge safely
records.problem: food residue and odours inside fridge
instructions: Remove food items and shelves.
Wash shelves and drawers with warm water and mild dish soap.
Wipe the fridge interior with a soft cloth and mild solution.
Dry all parts fully before replacing food.
donts: Do not use strong chemical odour cleaners inside food storage spaces

warnings: Ensure surfaces are dry before returning food.

records.title: Cleaning a microwave interior
records.problem: food splashes and odours inside microwave
instructions: Ensure the microwave is switched off.
Wipe loose crumbs first.
Use a bowl of warm water with lemon slices or mild detergent solution to loosen residue if needed.
Wipe interior surfaces with a soft cloth.
Dry thoroughly.
donts: Do not use abrasive pads

warnings: Do not allow liquid to enter vents.

records.title: Cleaning kitchen worktops safely
records.problem: food residue and everyday dirt on kitchen worktops
instructions: Remove crumbs and loose debris first.
Wipe with warm water and mild dish soap using a soft cloth.
Rinse with a clean damp cloth.
Dry using a clean towel or microfiber cloth.
dos: Wipe surfaces after preparing raw foods
donts: Do not use harsh chemicals on food preparation surfaces unless suitable and rinsed correctly

warnings: Rinse thoroughly if any cleaning product is used on food-contact surfaces.

records.title: Cleaning a stainless steel sink
records.problem: soap marks, food residue, and dullness in sink
instructions: Rinse away food debris first.
Apply mild dish soap and warm water using a soft sponge.
Rinse thoroughly.
Dry and buff following the steel grain.
donts: Do not use steel wool

warnings: Avoid abrasives on polished finishes.

records.title: Cleaning bathroom tiles and grout
records.problem: soap scum, mildew, and dirt on tiles and grout
instructions: Open a window or use ventilation before cleaning.
Apply warm water with mild detergent or a tile-safe cleaner.
Scrub grout gently with a soft brush.
Rinse thoroughly with clean water.
Dry surfaces to reduce future mould growth.
donts: Do not use metal brushes on grout
Do not mix multiple cleaning chemicals

warnings: Use gloves if skin is sensitive.
Good ventilation is important when cleaning bathrooms.

records.title: Removing limescale from shower glass
records.problem: limescale and water marks on shower screen
instructions: Spray the glass with a vinegar and water solution or a limescale-safe cleaner.
Leave the solution on for a few minutes.
Wipe with a soft sponge or microfiber cloth.
Rinse thoroughly with clean water.
Dry the glass to reduce future water spotting.
dos: Clean regularly to prevent heavy limescale build-up
donts: Do not use abrasive pads on coated glass

warnings: Never mix vinegar-based cleaners with bleach.

records.title: Cleaning chrome taps with limescale
records.problem: limescale on chrome taps
instructions: Wipe the taps with a soft cloth soaked in a mild vinegar solution or appropriate limescale remover.
Leave briefly if needed.
Wipe clean and rinse well.
Dry with a microfiber cloth.
dos: Dry taps after use where possible
donts: Do not use abrasive scourers

warnings: Avoid prolonged contact with acidic solutions on delicate finishes.

records.title: Cleaning a toilet hygienically
records.problem: hygienic cleaning of toilet bowl and exterior
instructions: Apply toilet cleaner to the bowl and allow it to sit as directed.
Scrub the bowl using a toilet brush.
Wipe exterior surfaces with a separate cloth and suitable cleaner.
Dispose of cleaning materials appropriately and wash hands.
dos: Use separate cleaning cloths for toilet areas
donts: Do not use the same cloth for other bathroom surfaces

warnings: Use gloves where appropriate.
Ensure ventilation when using strong cleaners.

records.title: Treating bathroom mould safely
records.problem: visible mould on bathroom surfaces
instructions: Open windows or switch on extraction before cleaning.
Wear gloves and avoid direct contact with mould.
Apply an appropriate mould-cleaning product or diluted vinegar if suitable.
Gently wipe or scrub the affected area.
Dispose of used cloths safely and wash hands afterwards.
Improve ventilation and reduce moisture to prevent recurrence.
donts: Do not mix mould removers with other chemicals
Do not ignore repeated mould growth without addressing moisture source

warnings: Wear gloves.
Avoid inhaling mould spores in poorly ventilated spaces.

records.title: Descaling a showerhead
records.problem: limescale blocking a showerhead
instructions: Remove the showerhead if possible.
Soak it in a vinegar and water solution for 20 to 30 minutes.
Scrub gently with a soft brush.
Rinse thoroughly before reattaching.
donts: Do not force removal if fixed tightly without proper guidance

warnings: Never mix vinegar with bleach.

records.title: Cleaning wooden furniture safely
records.problem: dust and sticky marks on wooden furniture
instructions: Dust the surface using a dry microfiber cloth.
For sticky marks, use a slightly damp cloth with minimal mild soap.
Wipe gently and avoid soaking the surface.
Dry immediately with a clean cloth.
dos: Test products on a hidden area first
donts: Do not soak wood
Do not use abrasive cleaners

warnings: Excess moisture may warp or damage wood finishes.

records.title: Cleaning a fabric sofa safely
records.problem: dust, marks, and general dirt on sofa fabric
instructions: Vacuum the sofa using an upholstery attachment.
Blot small marks with a damp cloth and mild fabric-safe cleaner.
Avoid soaking the fabric.
Allow the area to air dry fully.
dos: Test cleaner on a hidden area first
donts: Do not saturate the fabric
Do not scrub aggressively

warnings: Check the furniture care label if available.

records.title: Cleaning a leather sofa
records.problem: dust and marks on leather upholstery
instructions: Dust using a soft dry cloth.
Wipe with a lightly damp cloth if needed.
Use a leather-safe cleaner for marks if appropriate.
Dry immediately.
donts: Do not soak leather
Do not use harsh cleaners

warnings: Test leather products on a small hidden area first.

records.title: Cleaning a TV or monitor screen safely
records.problem: dust and fingerprints on a screen
instructions: Switch the device off and allow the screen to cool.
Use a dry microfiber cloth to remove dust.
If needed, use a screen-safe cleaner applied to the cloth, not directly to the screen.
Wipe gently.
donts: Do not spray liquid directly on the screen
Do not use abrasive cloths

warnings: Avoid moisture entering electrical components.

records.title: Reducing dust in a living room
records.problem: frequent dust build-up in living room
instructions: Dust surfaces with a microfiber cloth rather than a dry duster that redistributes particles.
Vacuum floors and soft furnishings regularly.
Clean high surfaces and overlooked corners.
Wash throws, cushion covers, and curtains where appropriate.
donts: Do not dry-dust in a way that stirs dust into the air unnecessarily

records.title: Maintaining clean bedding
records.problem: keeping bedding clean and fresh
instructions: Change bedding regularly.
Wash according to the fabric care label.
Dry fully before putting clean bedding back on the bed.
Air the mattress and room where possible.
donts: Do not leave damp bedding folded or bundled

records.title: Refreshing and cleaning a mattress surface
records.problem: dust and freshness of a mattress
instructions: Strip bedding and vacuum the mattress surface using an upholstery attachment.
Spot-clean marks carefully using a small amount of fabric-safe solution if needed.
Allow the mattress to air before replacing bedding.
donts: Do not soak the mattress

warnings: Ensure mattress is fully dry before remaking the bed.

records.title: Dusting wardrobes and bedroom furniture
records.problem: dust build-up on wardrobes and bedroom furniture
instructions: Dust surfaces with a microfiber cloth.
Wipe handles and frequently touched areas using mild soap solution if needed.
Dry surfaces afterwards.
donts: Do not oversaturate surfaces

records.title: Removing coffee stains from carpet
records.problem: coffee spill on carpet
instructions: Blot the spill immediately with a clean dry cloth.
Apply a small amount of cold water to dilute the stain.
Blot again rather than rubbing.
Use a mild carpet-safe detergent if needed.
Rinse lightly and blot dry.
donts: Do not scrub aggressively
Do not soak the carpet

warnings: Test detergent on a hidden area first.

records.title: Treating a red wine stain on carpet
records.problem: red wine stain on carpet
instructions: Blot immediately with a clean cloth.
Apply cold water and continue blotting.
Use a carpet-safe stain treatment if needed.
Blot until the stain lightens.
donts: Do not rub the stain deeper into fibres

warnings: Test stain products on an inconspicuous area first.

records.title: Removing coffee stains from fabric
records.problem: coffee stain on fabric
instructions: Blot excess liquid with a clean cloth.
Rinse the stained area with cold water from the back if possible.
Apply mild liquid detergent to the stain.
Gently work it in and rinse.
Wash according to the care label.
donts: Do not use hot water initially

warnings: Test delicate fabrics carefully.

records.title: Removing grease stains from fabric
records.problem: grease stain on clothing or fabric
instructions: Blot excess grease gently.
Apply a small amount of mild washing-up liquid to break down grease.
Rinse and wash according to the care label.
donts: Do not use hot heat drying until stain is removed

records.title: Cleaning wooden floors safely
records.problem: dust and marks on wooden floor
instructions: Sweep or vacuum with an appropriate floor attachment.
Use a lightly damp mop with a wood-safe cleaning solution if needed.
Dry any excess moisture immediately.
dos: Use products suitable for wood floors
donts: Do not soak the floor
Do not use abrasive floor tools

warnings: Excess water can damage wood flooring.

records.title: Cleaning tiled floors
records.problem: dust and dirt on tiled floors
instructions: Sweep or vacuum first.
Mop with warm water and mild floor cleaner.
Allow to dry or dry with a clean mop head if necessary.
donts: Do not leave heavy pools of water on grout lines

warnings: Wet floors may be slippery while drying.

records.title: Cleaning a kitchen bin and reducing odours
records.problem: bad smells and residue in kitchen bin
instructions: Empty the bin completely.
Wash the inside with warm water and mild detergent.
Rinse and dry thoroughly.
Add a fresh liner and use odour-control material if suitable.
dos: Dry completely before inserting a new liner
donts: Do not leave damp residue in the bottom of the bin

warnings: Wash hands after cleaning waste containers.

records.title: Cleaning a fabric couch with visible dirt or stains
instructions: Vacuum the couch thoroughly to remove loose dust and debris.
Blot stained areas gently with a clean cloth.
Use a mild upholstery-safe cleaner on affected areas.
Test any cleaner on a small hidden area first.
Allow the couch to dry fully before use.
dos: Check the fabric care label if available
donts: Do not soak the fabric
Do not use bleach unless the manufacturer guidance allows it
Do not scrub harshly as this may damage the fabric
safety: Test cleaning products on a hidden area first
Ensure the room is ventilated while cleaning

records.title: Cleaning cutlery with stuck food
records.problem: food stuck on spoons, forks, or knives
instructions: Rinse the cutlery under warm water first.
Soak the item in warm water with mild dish soap for a few minutes.
Use a soft sponge or dish brush to remove the stuck food.
Rinse thoroughly.
Dry fully with a clean cloth or allow to air dry.
dos: Soak first if food is dried on
donts: Do not use steel wool on polished cutlery
Do not leave metal items wet for long periods if prone to water marks

warnings: Take care with sharp utensils when washing.

records.source: General dishwashing and kitchen cleaning guidance

records.title: Cleaning greasy plates and cookware
records.problem: greasy plates and cookware
instructions: Scrape food debris into the bin first.
Soak greasy items in warm water with dish soap for a few minutes.
Wash using a sponge or brush.
Rinse thoroughly and dry.
dos: Use warm water if safe for the material
donts: Do not stack items with heavy grease without pre-rinsing if possible

warnings: Take care with sharp knives or broken items in washing water.

records.title: Cleaning a study desk or workstation
records.problem: dust and marks on study desk
instructions: Remove items from the desk surface.
Dust the area with a microfiber cloth.
Wipe marks gently with a lightly damp cloth and mild cleaner if suitable.
Dry before replacing electronics or papers.
donts: Do not spray cleaner directly onto plugs or electrical devices

warnings: Keep moisture away from electrical equipment.
